positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Automation, Software engineering in Test. 
Design, write and create various type of automation tests for the Next Generation FIrewall product and its features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Python, Django, RobotFramework, Jenkins, Automation, Software engineering in Test, Development

Over 4 years experience in Programming, Automation and Software engineering in Test. Using Python, Robotframework, Jenkins to build fully automated QA/Testing environment, setups and framework. Mostly used Python and Robotframework (Pybot) to develop fully automated test case and benchmark. Also setup and maintained multiple servers (Win2012R2, Ubuntu, CentOS, RedHat, SUSE, etc) for testing. 

Accomplishments include:
- Built QA framework & Test cases from scratch. There was no QA infrastructure, so we built QA / Testing environment from zero. In hardware apsect, I built motherboard setup, installed OS, Installed necessary library files and applications, setting hardware and deployed it. In software aspect, we built QA Automated Testing environment by using fio, Python, Pybot, Jenkins, IOmeter, Shellscript and Windows batch files. Test cases were written in Python and Pybot. Jenkins sent terminal command to kickstart those test cases and collect the results. Also remote power switch helped us to handle power manage control.

- Setup & Maintained various OS and servers (OS: Windows 2012 R2, Windows 2016 Preview, Redhat Enterprise, SUSE Enterprise, OpenSUSE, Ubuntu, CentOS. Servers: Dell, HP, Ecostream, MB setups, Linux box)

- Fully automated Benchmark. I was using Python to run from 150 test to 4000 test case. Every single test ran, Python collected and parsed each log, and created one big log file. Once test is completed, my benchmark code parsed the log, collect data for the same category test, plot the graphs using gnuplot, create HTML report, upload it to FTP server, and send email to the company about the results with report web link. 

- Created multiple Internal tools by Python, Django, Javascript and Shell script

- Backend programming. I was using Django, Python and gnuplot to generate performance graph comparison tool in real time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
NASTEC Engineering was my senior design project team, and my role was software engineer and embedded software engineer. NASTEC Engineering was developing wearable electronics for Human Interface Branch of NASA. 

- Used C language to do firmware programming
- Firmware controlled CO, CO2 and O2 sensors to measure in real time, and send data to the MCU
- Also wrote a library for OLED screen printing by using C. This library helped to display character on the OLED screen we used. 
- Using XBee to wireless communication. Our unit communicated with a laptop and send data in real time to plot a graph on the laptop

Paper published:
https://openurl.ebsco.com/EPDB%3Agcd%3A11%3A5572203/detailv2?sid=ebsco%3Aplink%3Ascholar&id=ebsco%3Agcd%3A102025344&crl=f&link_origin=www.google.com

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
I had worked as a software engineer at Cisco since 2010 include 3 summer internships (2010, 2011 and 2012). I had developed multiple software tools such as Source Code Verification, Testbed Reservation System and upgraded and configured multiple Testbeds/Lab equipments. 

              - Software Engineer & Tool Development
       o Developed several tools (PHP, Linux, Apache, MySQL, Grails, TCL)
       o Maintained source code (Updated CUCM OS) by Clear Case administrator
       o Released source code in ISO form (CUCM OS) by Clear Case Administrator
       o Worked under Agile/Scrum environment
       o Ran QA test for Cisco Cius Android Tablet
       o Built Testbeds Reservation System (Modified PHP open source project)
       o Developed and deployed Testbed topologies by Javascript, HTML

              - Hardware & Lab/Testbeds environment
       o Setup and Updated Lab/Testbeds environment
       o Created a new Testbeds
       o Replaced 3 MGCP gateways for updated Testbeds
       o Replace two HP servers to IBM i5 series servers
       o Updated multiple Lab/Testbeds (Gateways, Switches, multiple phones, Camelot Servers)
       o Built two HP Linux Apache servers and maintained Automation Team Wikis
